basic_info.description: Rarely available stylish TOP FLOOR condo in the heart of the Mission, one of SF's warmest, most vibrant & in-demand areas. 1 block to Flour+Water, Central Kitchen, Salumeria, Southern Pacific Brewing & many other culinary delights. Behind the beautiful Victorian facade is an extensively renovated modern building offering tremendous value to discerning buyers. The condo boasts an open and fluid floor plan including living room w/ fireplace open to the dining area and modern kitchen all with access to the front balcony overlooking downtown. Both back bedrooms step out to a large deck, ideal for soaking the sun or entertaining guests, while admiring the views of Twin Peaks. The hallway includes a 2nd bathroom and in-unit W/D. A true must-see.
